requirement: Write a scikit-learn compatible transformer that clips outliers in each feature to quantiles learned on training data, usable with clone, fit_transform and Pipeline.
skeleton: A QuantileClipper class deriving TransformerMixin and BaseEstimator with a params-only __init__, fit validating params and learning per-column quantiles, and a validated transform returning a clipped copy.
caption: A custom scikit-learn transformer that clips each feature to quantiles learned during fit, following the estimator contract so it clones and composes in pipelines. QuantileClipper subclasses TransformerMixin and BaseEstimator, and __init__ only stores lower, default 0.01, and upper, default 0.99. fit raises ValueError saying it requires 0 <= lower < upper <= 1 when the hyperparameters are invalid, converts x with check_array to float64, and stores per-column np.quantile bounds with axis 0 as lower_ and upper_ plus n_features_in_. transform calls check_is_fitted, so an unfitted call raises NotFittedError, raises ValueError with the expected and actual feature counts on a width mismatch, and returns a clipped copy from numpy. The fixture asserts default and cloned params, per-column bounds and clipping, that the input is not modified, that invalid quantiles fail at fit and not at init, NotFittedError and width errors, and use inside a pipeline.

plan.intent: Add robust outlier clipping to a model pipeline
constraints: __init__ only stores lower and upper so get_params and clone work
Invalid quantiles raise ValueError at fit time
A feature count mismatch raises ValueError

rationale.teaches: Follow the scikit-learn estimator contract: params-only __init__, validation and learned trailing-underscore attributes in fit, check_is_fitted and width checks in transform.
rationale.why: Validating in __init__ breaks clone and set_params, global bounds flatten differently scaled columns, and clipping in place corrupts the caller's training matrix.

ops.docstring: A scikit-learn compatible transformer clipping columns to fitted quantiles.

ops.source:
class QuantileClipper(TransformerMixin, BaseEstimator):  # type: ignore[misc]
    """Clip each feature to quantiles learned on the training data."""

    lower_: NDArray[np.float64]
    upper_: NDArray[np.float64]
    n_features_in_: int

    def __init__(self, lower: float = 0.01, upper: float = 0.99) -> None:
        self.lower = lower
        self.upper = upper

    def fit(self, x: ArrayLike, y: object = None) -> Self:
        """Learn per-column bounds; hyperparameters are validated here."""
        del y
        if not 0 <= self.lower < self.upper <= 1:
            raise ValueError("require 0 <= lower < upper <= 1")
        arr = check_array(x, dtype=np.float64)
        self.lower_ = np.quantile(arr, self.lower, axis=0)
        self.upper_ = np.quantile(arr, self.upper, axis=0)
        self.n_features_in_ = arr.shape[1]
        return self

    def transform(self, x: ArrayLike) -> NDArray[np.float64]:
        """Return a clipped copy of ``x``."""
        check_is_fitted(self)
        arr = check_array(x, dtype=np.float64)
        if arr.shape[1] != self.n_features_in_:
            raise ValueError(
                f"expected {self.n_features_in_} features, got {arr.shape[1]}"
            )
        clipped: NDArray[np.float64] = np.clip(arr, self.lower_, self.upper_)
        return clipped

candidates.why_wrong: Quantiles are computed over the whole matrix instead of per column.
Reversed quantiles are accepted and silently produce inverted bounds.
A width mismatch surfaces as an opaque numpy broadcasting error.
Clipping in place with out= rewrites the caller's float array.
The default upper quantile is 0.95 instead of 0.99.
